modules.module_title: Assist in preparing client for procedure

pcs.pc_description: wear appropriate and clean attire as per organizational policies and procedures
maintain conducive ambience, environment and cleanliness in the unit
introduce oneself to the client and communicate in a way to reflect gender sensitivity
empathize with Persons with Disability (PwD)
encourage the client to ask questions, seek advice and express any concerns
maintain client’s privacy
assist client in maintaining correct position and draping as per the instructions
ensure that personal articles of the individual are taken and kept secured as per organizational policies
assemble the required articles, herbs and related formulations as per prescription/therapist/doctor’s instructions
check the expiry date of formulations or material as per organizational policies
discard and maintain record of expired materials/ medicaments as per organizational policies
obtain necessary stock to replenish as per requirements
prepare panchakarma unit/set up as advised by the therapist/doctor
check that all equipment and tools are in working condition and safe to operate
place equipment and tools appropriately while ensuring safety and security

modules.module_title: Post procedure requirement of client and unit

pcs.pc_description: maintain client’s privacy
clean the client’s body as per organizational policies
handover client's articles such as jewelry, clothes and other valuables to client or relatives as per organizational policies
orient client about do’s and don’ts of related panchakarma session as per prescriptions/orders
maintain records and reports of the session
clean/ disinfect/ sterilize panchakarma set up and equipments as per the organization policies and procedures
pack and store equipments, materials and consumables used as per organizational policies and SOPs
check linen for grease, stains, damage and maintain record as per organizational policy
segregate rejected linen for wash or condemning as per organizational policy
organize documents, stationery, equipment and accessories as per work flow
check that all equipment and accessories are in working condition and safe to operate for next session
report any malfunction, damage, shortage of stock, missing item or sub-optimal performance to appropriate authority as per standard procedure

pcs.pc_description: maintain appropriate social distance as per specified protocols, for example, while greeting people, when in crowded places, using contactless mode of delivery of goods, etc.
carry out daily tasks using alternate methods e.g. virtual meetings, e-payments, etc.
follow recommended personal hygiene and sanitation practices, for example, washing/sanitizing hands, covering face with a bent elbow while coughing/sneezing, using PPE, etc.

follow recommended workplace hygiene and sanitation practices, for example, sanitizing workstation and equipment regularly, using disposable wipes and utensils, using alternative systems to mark attendance, etc.
clean and disinfect all materials/supplies before and after use.
segregate waste as per guidelines
dispose waste as per guidelines
keep abreast of the latest information and guidelines from reliable sources.
report signs and symptoms related to illness of self and others immediately to appropriate authority
seek help and guidance in case of stress and anxiety
